newsitem.title: USA: Rochester, N.Y., sells $78 mln note issue.
newsitem.headline: Rochester, N.Y., sells $78 mln note issue.

text.p: Rochester, N.Y., said Tuesday it sold $78 million of bond anticipation notes (BANs) through a competitive auction.

Roosevelt & Cross Inc said it won $45 million of the notes with a four percent coupon and a net interest cost (NIC) of 3.7162 percent. The firm also won $23 million with a four percent coupon and a 3.7232 percent NIC.
Fleet Securities Inc said it won $10 million with a coupon of four percent and a 3.70117 percent NIC.
Rochester also sold $7 million of revenue anticipation notes, which were won by BT Securities with a 4.5 percent coupon and a 3.568 percent NIC.
